name: OS Logging & Monitoring Assessment
description: Assessment of operating system logging, auditing, and monitoring configurations. Covers Windows Event Log architecture and audit policy (Security, Sysmon, PowerShell logging), Linux audit framework (auditd, journald, syslog), macOS Unified Logging, ETW provider configuration, log forwarding and SIEM integration, detection coverage gap analysis, and log integrity and retention evaluation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to OS logging and monitoring assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands OS logging architectures and security monitoring concepts
evidence: Can explain Windows Event Log, Linux syslog/journald, and macOS Unified Logging architecture
Understands the purpose of Sysmon, auditd, and PowerShell script block logging
Familiar with SIEM concepts and log forwarding mechanisms
Completed introductory training on security logging and monitoring

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews logging configurations and identifies gaps under supervision
evidence: Reviewed Windows audit policy and Sysmon configuration against best practices
Assessed auditd rules and journald configuration on Linux systems
Identified missing log sources and forwarding gaps using checklists
Documents logging assessment findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses logging configurations and detection coverage
evidence: Independently assesses OS logging across Windows, Linux, and macOS
Maps logging coverage against ATT&CK techniques to identify detection gaps
Evaluates log forwarding reliability, retention policies, and integrity controls
Produces logging assessment reports with actionable improvement recommendations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Designs comprehensive logging architectures; develops detection strategies
evidence: Develops comprehensive logging policies covering all OS platforms
Evaluates ETW provider configuration and advanced Windows telemetry sources
Assesses log pipeline reliability under adversarial conditions (log evasion, tampering)
Mentors team on logging assessment and detection engineering methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab logging assessment methodology; shapes monitoring strategy
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's OS logging assessment framework
Published guidance on OS logging best practices and detection coverage
Advises organizations on enterprise logging architecture and monitoring strategy
Trains teams on advanced logging assessment across all OS platforms

assessment_methods.description: Assess the logging and monitoring configuration of a mixed OS environment, mapping coverage gaps against ATT&CK techniques
Review OS logging assessment findings and detection coverage analysis from recent engagements

cis: CIS Controls v8.1 - Control 8 (Audit Log Management)
